2245.html:
2245 úpaviśati 'approaches' RV., 'sits down' ŚBr. — Pp. upaviṣṭa- 'seated' KātyŚr., °aka- 'remaining too long in the womb' Car. 2. upavēśayati 'causes to sit' AitBr. [√viś]
    Many forms present phonetic difficulty. Initial b-, in all lggs. except Gypsy (arm. as. pal.) and Sindhi, is poss. < early MIA. *uba- which, despite v- in arm. and pal. Gypsy, is more likely than later spread of b- forms from the East (where v- > b-). Contamination with vásati which by itself provides a verb 'to sit' in N. A. B. Or. Again nearly all, whether X vásati or not, have past stem or a new pres. stem from upaviṣṭa-.
    1. Pa. upavisati 'approaches', aor. upāvisi 'sat down'; Pk. uvavisaï, bēsaē 'sits': uvaviṭṭha-, biṭṭha-; Ap. baïsaï: baïṭṭha-; Gy. pal. wḗsăr 'stops, stays, sits': imper. wḗšti (founded on pp., cf. imper. ār 'come!' < ā́gata-), arm. ves- 'to sit', eur. beš-: boh. bešto 'lying', eng. bešto 'saddle'; Ḍ. bēšina 'to sit down': bēṭa; Kaṭ. baiṭhe 'we are sitting'; Tir. bēz- (z < -s-); baxta 'sitting' (X *vasta-); Bshk. bäy-: bāeṣṭ; Tor. baiyūsa (imper. bⁱhai): bēṭh, bēḍū; Phal. bhεš-, bhaš-: bhεṭ, bhaṭ; Sh. gil. băyóĭki̯ 'to sit, dwell' (< vásati?): bε῀ṭu, gur. koh. byōnṷ: bēṭu; K. bĕhun, bih°: byūṭhᵘ (beṭh m. 'sitting, delay'), kash. bihunᵘ; S. vehaṇu, vih°: veṭho; L. bêhaṇ, pres. part. bāhndā: beiṭhā, awāṇ. bâuṇ; P. baiṭhṇā, vaiṭhvā̃, bai° 'in a sitting position', bhaṭ. baiṭhĕā; WPah. cam. baihṇā, paṅ. biśuṇā, pāḍ. bēśaṇ: biṭṭhā, cur. bĕśṇū: bĕṭhā, roh. bašṇõ, boṭhṇõ, bhad. biśṇō, bhal. biśṇū (pp. biśśo); Ku. baiṭhaṇo 'to sit'; B. baisā, basā (< bais- ? or vásati?), dial. baiṭhā (ODBL 513); Or. baïṭhibā, baïṭhā; OMth. baisaï: Mth. baiṭhab; Bhoj. baisal, baiṭhal; OAw. baïsāī 'she was made to sit', baïṭhaï; H. baisnā: baiṭhā, baiṭhnā; OMarw. baïsāi caus.: baïthā, baiṭhaï; G. bεsvũ: bεṭho; M. baisṇẽ, bas°; Ko. baistā, bas°.
    2. Phal. bhεšū́- 'to make sit down'.
    upaviṣṭa- see prec.
    Addenda: úpaviśati (see also vásati). 1. WPah.kṭg. béśṇõ (pret. béśśɔ) 'to sit' (-e- X upavēśá-, etc. Him.I 140), caus. kṭg. (Wkc.) bəśέḷnõ 'to seat', OMarw. (Vīsaḷa) baïsāryaü caus. pret. 'made sit'.
    2. upaviṣṭa-: WPah.poet. bεṭhṇa 'to sit down' (← H.? Him.I 137), J. beṭhṇu, Garh. bεṭhṇu.
    upaviṣṭa- see úpaviśati Add².

8209.html:
8209 píbati 'drinks' RV. [√pā¹]
    Pa. pibati, pivati (pipa- in imper. pipa and pres. part. pipaṁ is prob. hyper-paliism for piva- or due to pipāsā-, &c.), NiDoc. pivaṁti 3 pl., Pk. pibaï, pi(v)aï, Gy. eur. pĭ̄-, arm. pi-, pal. pī-, Ḍ. pīna, Ash. pĭ̄-, Wg. Kt. pī-, Pr. wī-, Dm. pi-, Tir. Paš.pī-, Niṅg. Shum. pi-, Woṭ. pō- (pres. pōn, f. pyēn < *pivantō, °tī), Gaw. Kal. Kho. pi-, Bshk. Tor. pū- (< *piu- AO xviii 246), Phal. pī-, Sh.gil. pióĭki̯, koh. gur. pyōnṷ, K. (Lallā) piwun (cyonu 'to drink', caus. cyāwun with c < py??), S. piaṇu, L. pīvaṇ, P. pīṇā, WPah.bhad. bhal. pāḍ. paṅ. bhiḍ. pī-, cur. pe-, Ku. piṇo, N. piunu, A. piba, B. piyā, Or. piibā, Mth. piab, Bhoj. piyal, OAw. piaï, H. pīnā, OG. pīi, G. pīvũ, M. piṇẽ, Ko. pittā 3 sg. pres., Si. bonavā, pret. bīvā, pīma sb. 'drink, drinking'. — Pa. pivana- n. 'drinking'; Pk. pi(v)aṇa- n. 'drinking, milk'; Ku. piṇo 'mother's milk'; M. pīṇ f. 'sucking of the breasts'. — See Add.
    Addenda: píbati: S.kcch. pīṇū 'to drink', caus. pyārṇū 'to irrigate (a field)'; WPah.kṭg. (kc.) pīṇõ 'to drink', Garh. peṇu, caus. pilɔṇu; Md. bonī 'drinks' (absol. boi, boyi, bō; buim 'I drank, the act of drinking'), bovanī 'is thirsty'; bovenī 'gets drunk up'.
